name: Klein Moretti
title: Tingen, 1349
bio: A history graduate of Tingen University who woke at his own desk on the twenty-eighth of June in a body that had just shot itself, with somebody else’s memories arriving a beat behind his own.

name: Dunn Smith
title: Captain, Seventh Unit
bio: Runs the Tingen Nighthawks out of the second floor of No. 36 Zouteland Street, under a brass plate that says Blackthorn Security Company and a warrant card that says Seventh Unit, Special Operations Department, Awwa County Police. Forgets things, and knows he does.

name: Rozanne
title: Blackthorn’s receptionist
bio: Civilian, early twenties, and the only person in the building who knows where anything is filed. Books the appointments and countersigns the requisitions.

name: Leonard Mitchell
title: Nighthawk
bio: Handsome, idle, and the fastest man on the team to notice a thing nobody wanted noticed. Owes everyone in the office money.

name: Old Neil
title: Nighthawk
bio: Was a scholar before he was this, and explains the theory whether or not anybody asked, which is how the rest of the team learned any.

name: Sergeant Gorman
title: Awwa County Police
bio: Wrote up three deaths in one week as unrelated because he was told to, and has been sleeping badly since.

name: Mr. Franky
title: Your landlord
bio: Lets the terraces on Iron Cross Street. Wants the quarter on the day, is sorry about your friends, and would like the room repainted before anyone else has to look at it.

name: Hanass
title: Sold him the notebook
bio: One of the two men who put the Antigonus family’s notebook in Welch McGovern’s hands, and who has been extremely calm about it ever since.

name: Melissa Moretti
title: Your sister
bio: Technical school, top of her year, and doing sums about this household she should not have to be doing.

name: Quill of Alzuhod
title: Arranged the sale
bio: Never handles the goods and never signs anything. Arranged the notebook’s last change of owner and has not stopped wanting it back.

name: Welch McGovern
title: Deceased
bio: Read history under Associate Professor Cohen alongside you, bought a black hardcover notebook in May from men he should not have dealt with, and asked two friends to help him read it.

name: Sil Mowbray
title: Tussock ferry hand
bio: Works the night crossing, sees who goes over and when, and will tell you for the price of a drink he will not stop at one of.

name: Benson Moretti
title: Your brother
bio: Clerk at a shipping office and, since your father died, the reason this family still eats. He is the one who opened the door and found you.

name: Ray Bieber
title: Whoever has it now
bio: A name and an address on a parcel receipt in your own handwriting, posted on the night you do not remember. Whatever the notebook has been doing to him since, it has had eight days.

name: The Clown
title: Secret Order
bio: White paint, a red mouth, and manners. Wants the Antigonus family’s notebook, and is prepared to trade for it in the only currency you are short of: the name of the rung above you.

name: Audrey Hall
title: Miss Justice
bio: Answered a summons she had no way of receiving and behaved as though she had expected it. Very young, very well brought up, and taking notes.

name: Alger Wilson
title: Mr. Hanged Man
bio: Salt, powder and a captain’s caution. Said less than anyone at the first gathering and worked out more, which is its own kind of tell.

name: Daly Simone
title: Nighthawk
bio: Seconded to Tingen for the notebook, and the reason the team walks towards the thing everyone else is running from.
